about_the_game:
Some roll the dice. Not you, though. You turn them into weapons. Throw your dice into enemies' faces, knock them around, and conjure powerful spells from the face-up side. Upgrade your dice with magic and crazy physics to hold back endless waves of enemies. Welcome to the Game of Throws!

The Hardest Dice Game You Ever Played?

In Nice Dice, you defend the Evergamble Tree from swarms of walking, running, and even flying creatures in a roguelite survival.

You need sharp timing and aim, plus a strategic selection of dice spells and physics upgrades to succeed with your dice throws.

For example, you might craft a dice with slowing and stunning spells for your left hand, and a damage-over-time focused dice for your right. With countless spell and dice property combos, every attempt becomes a unique defense run.

Roguelite Dice Progress!

Defeating waves of enemies unlocks new spells for your dice sides: paralyzing thunderstorms, entangling vines, stone cascades, and more! The power of each spell scales with the number of dots on its side, so make sure you also invest in upgrading those!

For even more chaos and destruction, you can make your dice heavier to maximize impact damage, increase the effect radius, or even upgrade to loaded dice for more predictable spell outcomes.

And don't worry: even though each run starts with one weak dice (and later two), plenty of permanent upgrades carry over between runs!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated M1 GPU
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M3 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated M3 GPU or better
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
